properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.base-url
properties.description: base url of ops web ui and apis, used as the SpEL base of every ops controller mapping.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.secure.cert
properties.description: ops secure transfer cert (key pair) used by the front-end secure channel.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.app.enable
properties.description: enable app ops controllers.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.aws-s3.enable
properties.description: enable aws s3 ops controller.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.dashscope.enable
properties.description: enable dashscope ops controller, disabled by default.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.elasticsearch.enable
properties.description: enable elasticsearch ops controller.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.home.enable
properties.description: enable ops home controller and menu aggregation.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.host.enable
properties.description: enable host info ops controller.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.minio.enable
properties.description: enable minio ops controller.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.open-ai.enable
properties.description: enable openai ops controller, disabled by default.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.redis.enable
properties.description: enable redis ops controller.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.ssh.enable
properties.description: enable ssh ops controller.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.xproc4j.enable
properties.description: enable xproc4j ops controller.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.xxl-job.enable
properties.description: enable xxl-job ops controller.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.datasource.enable
properties.description: enable datasource ops controllers (datasource management and metadata).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.datasource.datasource-map
properties.description: managed datasources exposed by the datasource ops ui.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.datasource.datasource-map.*.driver
properties.description: jdbc driver class name.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.datasource.datasource-map.*.url
properties.description: jdbc url.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.datasource.datasource-map.*.username
properties.description: jdbc username.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.datasource.datasource-map.*.password
properties.description: jdbc password.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.enable
properties.description: enable the ops request limited filter (token bucket rate limit on ops apis).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.filter-url-pattern
properties.description: url pattern the ops limited filter is registered on, defaults to {i2f.springboot.ops.base-url}/* when blank.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.all-rule.enable
properties.description: enable the global (all requests) rate limit rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.all-rule.rate-per-second
properties.description: token refill rate (tokens per second) of the global rate limit rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.all-rule.capacity
properties.description: burst capacity (bucket size) of the global rate limit rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.every-ip-rule.lru-max-size
properties.description: max count of cached per client ip limiters (lru capacity), values not greater than 0 keep the filter default.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.every-ip-rule.rule.enable
properties.description: enable the per client ip rate limit rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.every-ip-rule.rule.rate-per-second
properties.description: token refill rate (tokens per second) of the per ip rate limit rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.every-ip-rule.rule.capacity
properties.description: burst capacity (bucket size) of the per ip rate limit rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.path-rules
properties.description: limited rules matched by ANT style request path, applied in declaration order.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.path-rules[].ant-path
properties.description: ANT style request path pattern of the limited rule, skipped when blank.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.path-rules[].rule.enable
properties.description: enable this path rate limit rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.path-rules[].rule.rate-per-second
properties.description: token refill rate (tokens per second) of this path rate limit rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ops.limited.path-rules[].rule.capacity
properties.description: burst capacity (bucket size) of this path rate limit rule.

properties.name: ai.openai.vision.image-max-size-kb
properties.description: max image size in kb when compressing images for vision requests.

properties.name: ai.openai.vision.image-max-dimension
properties.description: max image width/height when compressing images for vision requests.

properties.name: ai.openai.default-endpoint.enable
properties.description: whether the default openai compatible endpoint is available.

properties.name: ai.openai.default-endpoint.model
properties.description: model name of the default endpoint.

properties.name: ai.openai.default-endpoint.base-url
properties.description: base url of the default endpoint.

properties.name: ai.openai.default-endpoint.api-key
properties.description: api key of the default endpoint.

properties.name: ai.openai.dashscope-endpoint.enable
properties.description: whether the dashscope compatible endpoint is available.

properties.name: ai.openai.dashscope-endpoint.model
properties.description: model name of the dashscope endpoint.

properties.name: ai.openai.dashscope-endpoint.base-url
properties.description: base url of the dashscope endpoint.

properties.name: ai.openai.dashscope-endpoint.api-key
properties.description: api key of the dashscope endpoint.
